scope: Exposure-control RL research path (exposure_rl_control_v1). Action-admission invariants, declared-ledger identities, fold arithmetic, a bounded lifecycle model, Haskell conformance and a source audit. It proves nothing about profitability, future drawdown, solvency or production behaviour.

statusVocabulary.model_checked: explicit-state exploration of a bounded model to a fixed point
statusVocabulary.exhaustively_checked: every case of a stated finite set checked

assumptions.statement: The snapshot passed to the shield truthfully describes the account at decision time.
assumptions.risk: A wrong or stale snapshot voids every admission invariant; the shield only checks ranges and the freshness flag it is given.

assumptions.statement: Z3 4.15.4 is sound for the linear integer and nonlinear real queries used.
assumptions.risk: A solver defect could accept a false claim.

assumptions.statement: The syntax-tree translation of project() preserves the meaning of the restricted Python subset it accepts (integer assignments, if/else, comparisons, abs, min, _clamp).
assumptions.risk: A translator defect could prove a property of a different function; unsupported syntax is rejected rather than approximated.

assumptions.statement: The three-account Z3 mirror of reserve() matches the Python and Haskell functions.
assumptions.risk: Checked only by seeded conformance cases.

assumptions.statement: The declared ledger equations are the intended instrument accounting for a linear USD-margined perpetual held as a fraction of equity.
assumptions.risk: A wrong declaration would be proved faithfully.

assumptions.statement: Prices and funding are unaffected by the account's own trades and the next bar's open is tradable at the stated cost.
assumptions.risk: Market impact, queue position and gaps are outside the model.

assumptions.statement: The index model of fold_ranges matches the implementation.
assumptions.risk: Checked by a property test only.

assumptions.statement: The bounded lifecycle model is a faithful abstraction of the intended decision protocol.
assumptions.risk: No refinement proof links it to code.

assumptions.statement: GHC 9.4.8 compiles the shield correctly and enforces the module export list.
assumptions.risk: Compiler defects are out of scope.

assumptions.statement: The bounded conformance grid is representative of the inputs the shield receives.
assumptions.risk: Inputs outside the grid are covered by the SMT claims on the Python source and by the seeded sample only.

assumptions.statement: The audited source list is the complete research path.
assumptions.risk: Code added elsewhere is not audited until listed.

assumptions.statement: Every policy output passes through the shield before any intent exists.
assumptions.risk: True in the research environment by construction; a future consumer could bypass it.

assumptions.statement: Nothing in production consumes this path.
assumptions.risk: Checked for the listed Haskell sources by F-RLX-SURFACE.

entries.claim: In the bounded lifecycle model, reserved exposure never exceeds the budget, a submission follows only a shield admission and a fresh granted reservation, failures reach the hold fallback, no decision is submitted twice, a disabled challenger takes no step, only the operator changes the mode, no state holds a live-order capability, and every state can reach quiescence.
entries.formalStatement: In the bounded lifecycle model, reserved exposure never exceeds the budget, a submission follows only a shield admission and a fresh granted reservation, failures reach the hold fallback, no decision is submitted twice, a disabled challenger takes no step, only the operator changes the mode, no state holds a live-order capability, and every state can reach quiescence.
entries.result: Fixed point reached with no violation; the non-atomic mutant yields the expected budget counterexample.
entries.bounds: Two proposers, one decision each, one retry, three exposure levels, budget 2: 648 states and 1344 transitions.
entries.limitations: A bounded abstraction, not the implementation. The absence of a live-order transition is structural in the model; the implementation-level evidence is F-RLX-FORGERY and F-RLX-SURFACE. Real recovery actions, process crashes and persistence are not modelled.

entries.tool: GHC 9.4.8 compiled driver compared with the Python reference
entries.result: All 120080 shield cases and 4096 reservation cases agree; every outcome kind is exercised.
entries.bounds: 27 exposures x 7 drawdowns x 2 freshness x 8 headrooms x 37 binary64 raw values (signed edge values, subnormal, infinities, NaN) plus 8192 seeded random cases; 4096 seeded reservation cases.
entries.limitations: Exhaustive over the stated finite grid only; not a proof for all binary64 inputs or all snapshots. Compiled with -O0.

obligations.title: Causality
obligations.scope: Features, observations and training ranges of the research path.
openItems: Property-tested only; no proof of the feature code.
The champion-method export uses parameters chosen with later data; it is a comparator, not an RL input.

obligations.title: Partition integrity
obligations.scope: Reward maturity across fit, inner validation and test.
openItems: The implementation is linked to the proved index model by a property test.

obligations.title: Accounting
obligations.scope: The declared ledger; binary64 code by exact-rational conformance.
openItems: Exchange liquidation and margin are not modelled.

obligations.title: Action validation
obligations.scope: Decoding and rejection of raw proposals in Python and Haskell.
openItems: Binary64 decoding is checked on a bounded grid and a seeded sample, not for all inputs.

obligations.title: Risk admission
obligations.scope: Integer projection for every valid snapshot and proposal.
openItems: Pending orders, exchange precision, minimum notional and margin are not modelled; the environment has no pending orders.

obligations.title: Authorization
obligations.scope: The research path cannot construct an intent outside the shield or reach an order capability in the audited sources.

obligations.title: Lifecycle
obligations.scope: Bounded model plus source audit; the path contains no promotion code.
openItems: No refinement proof from the model to code.

obligations.title: Failure handling
obligations.scope: Invalid proposal, invalid snapshot, stale state and corrupt artifact reach a hold or reduce-only fallback.
openItems: Inference timeouts are modelled, not implemented: research inference is in-process and has no deadline.

obligations.title: Atomicity and freshness
obligations.scope: Pure compare-and-swap reservation and its bounded concurrent model.
openItems: No concurrent store implements the reservation; the research environment uses one account per symbol.

obligations.title: Noninterference
obligations.scope: The path is not linked into or imported by any production component; a disabled challenger takes no step in the model.

obligations.title: Recovery
obligations.scope: Retries, exactly-once submission and progress in the bounded model.
openItems: Real recovery actions, crashes and persistence are not modelled or implemented.
